name: Canvas Area
description: Core infinite canvas engine managing all plugins as draggable/resizable cards. World-to-screen coordinate transform: screenX = worldX * scale + panX. Supports pan (left/middle-click drag, Ctrl+drag anywhere), zoom (mousewheel 0.1x–5x, cursor-centered, Ctrl+wheel global), and grid rendering (dots/grid/none) via CSS background-image with scale and pan offset. Cards managed as CardState objects with PluginCard DOM. Z-order stacking via incrementing z-index with rebalance at 9998. State serialized to SaveState (plugins array with per-plugin editorState/markdownState/gitState, zOrder, zoom, panX, panY, locked). Plugin lifecycle: addTerminal/createExplorer/addGit/addMarkdown/addSpecsmap all create cards with separate plugins embedded in card body. Layout overlays for locked-mode drop zones (8 zones: top-left, top, top-right, left, right, bottom-left, bottom, bottom-right). Plugin list panel (lower-left hover zone) shows all cards with focus/terminate options via right-click context menu. Arrange panel (lower-right hover zone) with Auto Arrange, Tile Plugins (custom W×H in grid units), and Snap Origin. Status bar with zoom percentage, lock/unlock icon, workspace name, reset-zoom icon, and View All button. Animated pan using ease-out cubic over 300ms. fitAll scales to fit all open cards. Snap-to-28px grid for all coordinates. World bounds clamped to ±50000. SaveState JSON diff check prevents redundant saves.

dependencies.usage: Generate and apply dot/grid background patterns
Status bar widget for zoom/pan/workspace display
Draggable/resizable card container for all plugins
xterm.js PTY terminal emulator in card body
Git client with commit history, staging, and diff views
Right-click menu on card headers and empty canvas
Dependency graph viewer for spec files

methods.name: addTerminal
methods.description: Creates a new TerminalPlugin card on the canvas at an auto-positioned location.

methods.name: addExplorer
methods.description: Creates a new ExplorerPlugin card with FileExplorerPlugin and MonacoEditorPlugin in split layout.

methods.name: addGit
methods.description: Creates a new GitPlugin card with commit history, staging, and diff views.

methods.name: addMarkdown
methods.description: Creates a new MarkdownPlugin card. Returns the MarkdownPlugin instance or null if creation fails.

methods.name: addSpecsmap
methods.description: Creates a new SpecsMapPlugin card with dependency graph viewer for spec files.

methods.name: reopenTerminal
methods.description: Reopens a minimized/closed TerminalPlugin card by setting isOpen=true on the PluginCard.

methods.name: reopenExplorer
methods.description: Reopens a minimized/closed ExplorerPlugin card.

methods.name: reopenGit
methods.description: Reopens a minimized/closed GitPlugin card.

methods.name: reopenMarkdown
methods.description: Reopens a minimized/closed MarkdownPlugin card.

methods.name: reopenSpecsmap
methods.description: Reopens a minimized/closed SpecsMapPlugin card.

methods.name: focusTerminal
methods.description: Brings the TerminalPlugin card to front (increments z-index) and pans to make it visible.

methods.name: focusExplorer
methods.description: Brings the ExplorerPlugin card to front and pans to it.

methods.name: focusGit
methods.description: Brings the GitPlugin card to front and pans to it.

methods.name: focusMarkdown
methods.description: Brings the MarkdownPlugin card to front and pans to it.

methods.name: focusSpecsmap
methods.description: Brings the SpecsMapPlugin card to front and pans to it.

methods.name: cycleCard
methods.description: Cycles focus through open cards by direction: 1 for next card, -1 for previous card.

methods.name: getSaveState
methods.description: Returns the full serializable canvas state including plugins, zOrder, zoom, panX, panY, and locked.

methods.name: restorePlugins
methods.description: Recreates all plugin cards from a serialized SaveState including per-plugin editorState, markdownState, and gitState.

methods.name: restoreZOrder
methods.description: Restores the z-order stacking of all open cards from an array of UUIDs.

methods.name: setView
methods.signature: (state: { zoom: number, panX: number, panY: number }) => void
methods.description: Sets the canvas viewport to the given zoom and pan coordinates.

methods.name: centerView
methods.description: Centers the viewport to the average position of all open cards.

methods.name: resetView
methods.description: Resets zoom to 1.0 and pans to origin (0,0), equivalent to setting default viewport.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Increases zoom scale by one step, cursor-centered on canvas center.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Decreases zoom scale by one step, cursor-centered on canvas center.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a full canvas re-render: update grid pattern, reposition all cards, refresh status bar.

methods.name: setGridStyle
methods.description: Sets the grid rendering style (dots/grid/none) and regenerates the CSS background-image.

methods.name: autoArrange
methods.description: Auto-arranges all open cards in a grid layout with default 400x300 world units per card.

methods.name: offsetCard
methods.signature: (title: string, worldX: number, worldY: number) => void
methods.description: Offsets the position of a card identified by title by worldX, worldY delta.

methods.name: getActiveExplorerPlugin
methods.description: Returns the first open ExplorerPlugin instance, or null if none are open.

methods.name: getMarkdownLabels
methods.description: Returns the labels (titles) of all open MarkdownPlugin cards.

methods.name: openInMarkdown
methods.description: Opens the given file in a MarkdownPlugin. If label is provided, opens in that specific card; otherwise opens in the first available or creates a new one.

properties.name: locked
properties.description: Whether the canvas zoom/pan is locked. When locked, only Ctrl+wheel zoom is blocked, and layout drop zones are shown at 1x scale.

properties.name: workspaceName
properties.description: Display name of the current workspace, shown in the status bar.

events.name: onStateChange
events.description: Fired when canvas state changes (plugin add/remove/reposition, zoom/pan change). Used by App to trigger auto-save.

events.name: onTerminalsChanged
events.description: Fired when terminal plugin count changes (add/minimize/terminate). Callback receives list of terminal labels/titles.

events.name: onExplorersChanged
events.description: Fired when explorer plugin count changes.

events.name: onGitChanged
events.description: Fired when git plugin count changes.

events.name: onMarkdownChanged
events.description: Fired when markdown plugin count changes.

events.name: onSpecsmapChanged
events.description: Fired when specsmap plugin count changes.

events.name: onLockToggle
events.description: Fired when the locked state is toggled via the status bar zoom percentage click.

state.description: Serialized to .cockpit/window.json on state change via JSON diff check to prevent redundant saves.

fields.name: plugins
fields.description: Array of all plugin card entries, each with uuid, title, position, size, open state, and optional plugin-specific state (editorState, markdownState, gitState).

fields.name: zOrder
fields.description: Array of card UUIDs in front-to-back z-order. First element is topmost.

fields.name: zoom
fields.description: Current zoom scale factor, clamped to 0.1–5.0.

fields.name: panX
fields.description: Horizontal pan offset in screen pixels.

fields.name: panY
fields.description: Vertical pan offset in screen pixels.

fields.name: locked
fields.description: Whether canvas zoom/pan is locked. Optional, defaults to false.

lifecycle.created_by: App constructor — instantiates new CanvasArea(el) on the #canvas DOM element
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Window close / session end — process termination destroys all state
